rows.jyutping: biu2 jin6 dak1 hou2 jit6 cing4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone visibly shows enthusiasm without specifying how.

example.english: They enthuse whenever they talk about their cat.
example.traditional: 佢一講到自己隻貓，就表現得好熱情。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 gong2 dou3 zi6 gei2 zek3 maau1 zau6 biu2 jin6 dak1 hou2 jit6 cing4

rows.note: Use this when showing enthusiasm specifically by praising something or someone enthusiastically.

example.english: Everyone began to enthuse about this film, saying it was very thoughtfully made.
example.traditional: 大家都大讚呢套戲，話拍得好有心思。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 daai6 zaan3 ni1 tou3 hei3 waa6 paak3 dak1 hou2 jau5 sam1 si1
